'''Bevek Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] who served as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of House Thul's [[Thul Navy|naval force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], Bevek was planning an operation against [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] at the [[Outpost Eudor]] in the [[Kaamos Territory]]. However, his movements quickly became known to the enemy and he suspected that spies from House Organa were hiding in the nearby hills. Bevek Thul tasked an Imperial hero to kill these spies and retrieve any recordings they made. After the mission was completed, he suggested that he could name a future battleship in the Hero's name.
